lines.beaver_en: Hello. How can I help you today?
lines.learner: 생활비 관리 방법을 상담하고 싶어서 왔어요.
lines.en: I came to get advice on managing living expenses.
lines.roman: saenghwalbi gwalli bangbeobeul sangdamhago sipeoseo wasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 좋습니다. 요즘 어떤 점이 어려우세요?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jotseumnida. yojeum eotteon jeomi eoryeouseyo?
lines.en: My rent went up, so I'm short on living expenses.

lines.beaver: 한 달 생활비는 주로 어디에 쓰세요?
lines.beaver_en: What do you mostly spend your monthly living costs on?
lines.beaver_roman: han dal saenghwalbineun juro eodie sseuseyo?
lines.en: Food and transportation cost the most.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of account do you use?
lines.learner: 월급 계좌 하나로 결제도 다 하고 있어요.
lines.en: I make all payments from my one salary account.
lines.roman: wolgeup gyejwa hanaro gyeoljedo da hago isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 생활비 계좌를 따로 만들어 보시면 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: It's good to open a separate account for living costs.
lines.beaver_roman: saenghwalbi gyejwareul ttaro mandeureo bosimyeon joayo.
lines.learner: 그 방법은 한번 해 볼 만하네요.
lines.en: That method is worth a try.
lines.roman: geu bangbeobeun hanbeon hae bol manhaneyo.

lines.learner: 아니요, 아직 저축을 못 하고 있어요.
lines.en: No, I haven't been able to save yet.
lines.roman: aniyo, ajik jeochugeul mo tago isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 매달 돈을 넣는 적금 상품이 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: We have a savings plan where you deposit money every month.
lines.beaver_roman: maedal doneul neonneun jeokgeum sangpumi isseoyo.
lines.learner: 그 적금 상품은 들어 볼 만한가요?
lines.en: Is that savings plan worth signing up for?
lines.roman: geu jeokgeum sangpumeun deureo bol manhangayo?

lines.beaver: 네, 이자가 괜찮아요. 혹시 부채는 없으세요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the interest is good. Do you have any debt?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, ijaga gwaenchanayo. hoksi buchaeneun eopseuseyo?
lines.en: I have a little credit card debt, so I'm worried.

lines.beaver: 신용 관리도 중요하니 빚부터 갚으시는 게 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: Credit matters too, so it's best to pay off the debt first.
lines.beaver_roman: sinyong gwallido jungyohani bitbuteo gapeusineun ge joayo.
lines.learner: 네, 신용이 나빠지면 안 되니까 먼저 갚을게요.
lines.en: Okay, I can't let my credit get worse, so I'll pay it first.
lines.roman: ne, sinyongi nappajimyeon an doenikka meonjeo gapeulgeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋습니다. 이렇게 하면 돈을 잘 모으실 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Great. If you do this, you'll save money well.
lines.beaver_roman: jotseumnida. ireoke hamyeon doneul jal moeusil geoyeyo.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 이제 돈 걱정이 좀 줄겠네요.
lines.en: Thank you. Now I'll worry a bit less about money.
lines.roman: gamsahamnida. ije don geokjeongi jom julgenneyo.
